_comment: Degenerate single-combo grid pinned to the EXACT params from ugld.DefaultParams() (internal/service/trading_strategy/reversion/strategy/ugld/ugld.go). Used to run a rolling walk-forward of the ALREADY-CHOSEN params (no parameter search): each train fold can only pick this one combo, so the pooled OOS / per-fold output measures whether the fixed params survive out of sample. Run to MATCH the strategy: fraction 1, commission 0.0005, NO -risk-pct (CatStopATRMult=0 means fixed sizing).
